review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions: OddLine.mixFun_inl and mixFun_inr in MixShuffle.lean, and sumPowIns_prj_same, sumPowIns_prj_ne and sumPow_total in SuperEmbed/Standard.lean. I also grepped the repository for uses of the declarations defined here (mixSplitHom, mixSplitInv, mixSplitIso, constSumIso, mixSumPowIso). They appear only in this file, so no downstream simp calls depend on them. The file has no @[simp] attributes, so it has no orientation conflicts, competing rules or rewrite cycles. Its proofs call simp only with explicit lemma lists. The ι_inl_mixSplitHom and ι_inr_mixSplitHom lemmas are already @[reassoc] and are passed by name to simp only where needed. The only possible gaps are missing simp lemmas or @[simps] for the Iso structures (mixSplitIso, constSumIso). They would be speculative: nothing uses them, and sibling files in this directory (for example MixShuffle) also leave the analogous mixSucc lemmas without @[simp]. I did not recommend simp annotations because of a lemma's shape alone. I could not run Lean, so I did not test anything.
